answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by making each identity post a bond that is slashed on fraud: like staking a claim in the tundra, one honest identity costs little, but a thousand clones must lock a thousand bonds. A lagoon of random peer audits then samples identities and burns the bond of any clone sharing hardware fingerprints or identical behavior, while the quartz-hard rule that reputation cannot be transferred means a fake army inherits no trust and must pay full price for every copy.
